name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.GGH15.path_identity
title: GGH15 functionality as an exact identity (CVW18 Lemma 5.3, Eq. (10))
statement: If A_i D_{i,b} = S_{i,b} A_{i+1} + E_{i,b} for all levels and bits (any commutative ring), then for every path x: A_0 D_x = S_x A_h + sum_j (S_{x_0}...S_{x_{j-1}}) E_{j,x_j} (D_{x_{j+1}}...D_{x_{h-1}}), the exact form of the honest GGH15 evaluation (CVW18 Eq. (10)).
